needVariable: Switch on a layer or open a chart to choose a variable.
trendIntro: Each mark is the change per decade of the chosen variable at one place.
trendLength: Longer: a bigger change per decade
trendHollow: Outline only and shorter: not significant, or significant before FDR correction only
trendUnreliable: Crossed triangle, dashed and faded: not reliable as a climate signal because of a documented trend-affecting data issue
trendNoData: Grey dot: no result at this place
trendLengthScale: Length is scaled to the 90th percentile of the changes shown for this variable.
gapIntro: Each disc compares the trend of a model with the trend of a station at one place.
gapHalves: Left half: model trend. Right half: station trend. Same colour scale.
gapRing: Outer ring: thicker means the monthly anomalies agree less (1 minus correlation).
gapObsWarn: Orange dot: the observed series has a documented sampling problem.
gapModelStripes: Striped left half: the model series has a documented step. Crossed triangle: a model or station trend is not reliable as a climate signal.
gapOnlyTemperature: Only temperature variables have a station to compare with. Choose a temperature layer.
gapModelSelect: Model temperature for comparison (independent of the selected layer)
alikeIntro: Arcs join the chosen place to the places whose other variables move most like its chosen variable.
alikeColour: Yellow: moves the same way. Pink: moves the opposite way.
alikeDashed: Dashed: not significant, or much weaker, once each series has its own linear trend removed.
alikeNotCause: Moving alike is not cause and effect; many pairs share only a long-term trend.
alikeSource: The file lists other variables only, not the same variable at other places.
alikeNone: No similar series listed for this variable at this place.
notReliable: not reliable as a climate signal (documented data issue)
